clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity’s Magic Quarter, Godrick Farsan aids Forsaken warlocks beside Carendin Halgar. Though blind, he says he sees in a different way.

Among the summoning circles in the Magic Quarter, Godrick Farsan aids Master Carendin Halgar as he guides aspiring Forsaken warlocks. Godrick is blind, yet says he sees in a different way and does not explain how. He tests those who seek to bind greater demons, sending them to gather pure hearts and essences for intricate summoning rites.
